description: main.py cascade wiring (fresh vs resume decided once per NIT 4, provenance blocks, frozen stage in RunCheckpoint, fingerprint check, recalibration and re-freeze), check_mixed_run.py cascade / bn-recal / skip / grad-balance / g_gap options, and the local end-to-end tiny level-4 -> level-2 -> resume run. Plan items 8, 9, 14. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Read design.md §2.1, §9, §13, §15, §16 T8, T12 and the local e2e plan, plan.md items 8, 9, 14 (NIT 4), and FEAT-001/FEAT-002 findings first.

main.py: before any model is built compute cascade_resume = bool(args.resume) and C.peek_last_step(os.path.join(args.results, args.run_name, 'ckpt', 'last')) > 0 (NIT 4). Fresh cascade run: C.load_cascade_source(args.cascade_from) and C.check_cascade_config (ValueError -> SystemExit('main.py: --cascade-from %s: %s')), frozen = FrozenStage.from_checkpoint(prefix, src_cfg), model.copy_weights_from(frozen.model), init_info = C.cascade_init_record(model, info), cascade block {source_checkpoint, source_config, source_level, source_step, fingerprint, S_rel_diff_vs_level4, skip_prob} where S_rel_diff_vs_level4 = ||S2-S4||_F/||S4||_F with S4 = postprocess.brain_S_matrix(4, template_dir) on the DALI path (return it from _build_dali_data or compute in main) and null on the overfit path. Resume: §9 steps 1-6 (config.json cascade required else RuntimeError('resume of a cascade run without config.json cascade: <path>'); source NOT read; FrozenStage.from_config(model_cfg); RunCheckpoint(extra=dict(trainer.checkpoint_variables(), frozen_stage=frozen.model)); restore_last() must return True; weight_fingerprint vs saved (n_vars exact, sums rel 1e-12) else RuntimeError naming both; re-freeze iff saved bn_recalibration.freeze is True then rebuild_steps(); write_config carries init_weights / cascade / bn_recalibration verbatim). Trainer(..., cascade=frozen). Fresh write order: write_config (with init_weights + cascade), log_params, init_weights event, recalibrate_bn(args.bn_recal_batches, args.bn_recal_freeze) if K>0, second write_config with bn_recalibration, then fit. Print cascade info lines unless --quiet. Non-cascade paths byte-identical. Update the main.py docstring and add the NIT 4 sentence ('--resume false on an existing run dir is a fresh run ...') to design.md §9.

tests/test_cascade.py T8 TestCascadeResume per §16 T8 (RunCheckpoint save/restore with frozen_stage, frozen outputs identical 1e-7, tampered fingerprint RuntimeError, config.json without cascade RuntimeError, main-level run through main.main([...]) on --overfit-one-group --overfit-synthetic TINY: fresh level-4 source run, level-2 cascade run with --bn-recal-batches 8, then resume with the source moved away, blocks equal, stats_frozen re-applied with --bn-recal-batches 0 on resume, exactly one bn_recalibration event and bitwise-restored BN stats when the resume passes --bn-recal-batches 8). Use --gpu-memory-limit-mb 6000 only if the test process has not configured the GPU yet (tf_setup already does; do not pass it twice if it errors).

tests/test_main.py: cascade overfit smoke (level-2 run with --cascade-from a tiny level-4 run exits with a defined code, config.json has cascade with source_level 4 and init_weights.via == 'cascade', S_rel_diff_vs_level4 is null) and the error case (--cascade-from a level-2 source -> SystemExit mentioning the level).

tests/gpu/check_mixed_run.py: options --expect-cascade, --expect-bn-recal, --expect-skip, --grad-balance-rule, --grad-balance-from-step (default 50; help states it filters on the record's step field = window end, first window 26-50 with --log-every 25) exactly per §13: cascade provenance checks, final-step val_<task>_frozen keys and val_deform_frozen/{template_dice,pair_dice}, INFO cascade_gain lines (better/worse, never fail), data-wait fraction INFO, g_gap <task> INFO lines (composed and frozen; {center,pair}_{rms_mm,rot_deg,trans_mm} and for affine {center,pair}_{scale_pct,shear_pct,qr_rot_deg}), bn_recalibration event checks (n_layers_updated > 0, layers_without_updates == [], gap INFO when non-empty), skip-frac check, grad_balance KEEP task-grad-norm / FALLBACK deform:64 / UNDECIDED (treat as FALLBACK and inspect the run) excluded from the PASS/FAIL tally. All defaults off. Update the docstring.

tests/test_check_mixed_run.py: T12 cases (cascade pass; missing val_rigid_frozen FAIL; bn-recal event missing FAIL; KEEP 1.3/0.7; FALLBACK one ratio 40; UNDECIDED; step cut 25 excluded / 50 included; empty gap table passes; existing level-4 cases unchanged).

Local e2e (plan item 14): write .agents/tmp/e2e.sh (tf_gpu, set +u before conda activate, TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0, TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512, results root /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.agents/tmp/e2e_results, every main.py call with --gpu-memory-limit-mb 6000 and the TINY flags --filters 8,16,16,16,16,16 --reductions 16,8 --dense 64,32 --decoder-widths 8,8,8,8,8 and --val-png true). (1) main.py --overfit-one-group --overfit-synthetic --level 4 --task-ratio rigid:1,affine:1,deform:2 --group-size 4 --deform-group-size 2 --overfit-max-steps 150 --lambda-ncc-template 1 --lambda-ncc-pair 1 --run-name e2e_l4. (2) main.py --overfit-one-group --overfit-synthetic --level 2 --cascade-from <results>/e2e_l4/ckpt/last --task-ratio rigid:1,affine:1,deform:2 --group-size 4 --deform-group-size 2 --bn-recal-batches 8 --overfit-max-steps 150 --lambda-ncc-template 1 --lambda-ncc-pair 1 --task-grad-norm 12 --run-name e2e_l2 (exit 1 = overfit threshold not reached is acceptable; any traceback is not), then python tests/gpu/check_mixed_run.py <results>/e2e_l2 --tasks rigid,affine,deform --steps 150 --expect-best false --expect-init-weights full --expect-enc-grad true --expect-cascade true --expect-bn-recal true --grad-balance-rule true. (3) rerun (2) with --overfit-max-steps 160 --resume true; diff config.json init_weights/cascade/bn_recalibration before vs after (python one-liner); checker with --steps 160. Run in the background if it exceeds the 120 s tool timeout (pass an explicit timeout up to 1800000 ms). Record numbers, then delete .agents/tmp/e2e.sh and .agents/tmp/e2e_results.

Run verification; set status completed; findings: e2e numbers (trace counts, composed vs frozen train-mode/val errors, folding, bn gap pre/post, grad_balance verdict and ratios, median step ms per task, S_rel_diff null), checker output lines, any deviation.
acceptance_criteria: Goldens TestLinearOnlyUnchanged / TestDeformUnchanged max |diff| 0 after the main.py change

Checker output lines (run 2): PASS final_step, train_*, val_*, val_mean_pair_rms_mm, trace_once, finite_steps, val_png, init_weights (mode full), enc_grad_* , cascade_config, val_{rigid,affine,deform}_frozen, bn_recalibration; INFO cascade_gain_{affine,deform,rigid} (better), data_wait_*, g_gap_{rigid,affine}[_frozen] ('no <task>_g validation set' in overfit mode), bn_gap_*, grad_balance KEEP. DEVIATIONS: (a) the e2e commands also pass --integration-steps 3 to BOTH levels and --gradient-checkpointing both to the level-2 runs (FEAT-002 finding: a level-2 deform training step OOMs at 6000 MB with T 7 / no checkpointing; integration_steps is a ModelConfig field, so the source needs it too); --log-backend jsonl added. (b) The main-level tests (T8, test_main) run rigid-only with --deform-decoder true (identical ModelConfig across levels, no level-2 deform trace) to keep them ~2-4 min; the three-task path is covered by the e2e. (c) S_rel_diff_vs_level4 is computed only on the DALI path (not args.overfit_one_group): S4 = postprocess.brain_S_matrix(4, <data>/template), so a real-data overfit run also writes null. (d) SystemExit message: 'main.py: ' + the ValueError text when it already starts with '--cascade-from' (load_cascade_source / check_cascade_config messages do), else 'main.py: --cascade-from <path>: <msg>' (avoids a doubled prefix). (e) On resume a saved config.json without a bn_recalibration key keeps it absent (copied only when present) so the provenance diff stays exact; also recorded in design.md section 9. (f) The checker's INFO lines keep passed=True (as the m7 enc_grad_ratio) with detail prefix 'INFO' and are printed with the label INFO (the existing enc_grad_ratio line now prints INFO instead of PASS; tally unchanged); --grad-balance-rule also runs the enc-grad checks ('implies'). (g) On a cascade resume restore_last() returning False raises RuntimeError (NIT 4). OBSERVATIONS: TF prints 'N out of the last M calls to Trainer._cascade_val_fn.<locals>.fwd triggered retracing' in cascade runs: one tf.function per validation key plus rebuild_steps() after the freeze (FEAT-002 design, traced once per key per build), cosmetic. The RuntimeError resume paths leave metrics.jsonl unclosed (ResourceWarning in the test only, the process exits). The e2e fresh run's phantom at level 4 is unrelated to the level-2 phantom (design caveat), so 'composed < frozen' there mainly shows that the residual learns; T16b remains the non-trivial local evidence.
